text:
jordan: Quick check — iterating on the alerting hero panel layout. Screenshot + figma here https://figma.com/file/xyz — worried the top density feels too airy and the threshold helptext is still confusing. thoughts? maria: looks good overall. agree top padding feels large on 1280px view. can we tighten the header by 8px? keith: +1 on reducing padding. also the current helptext for thresholds says 'percentage of errors' which is vague. suggest: 'Percentage of requests failing over the past 5m'. shorter, clearer. sam: love that copy tweak. also flagging a11y: the alert severity color for "warning" is 3.1:1 on our palette — fails AA for small text. need contrast 4.5:1. jordan: thanks — keith/sam noted. for the notification channels control, I'm debating pill selector vs dropdown. Pills show channel badges nicely but take horizontal space. dropdown hides info. any preferences? maria: pill selector if we can show channel icons and a condensed count like '+2' when many. that preserves visibility in the preview. keith: if we use pills, ensure keyboard focus order is linear and the pill group has role="listbox" + aria-activedescendant. small patch below: ```
``` sam: looks fine. also the channel preview panel needs to show suppression state (snoozed vs muted). maybe a dimmed pill with overlay icon? jordan: good call — visually dim + :zzz: icon. copy for suppression tooltip: 'Temporarily suppress notifications from this channel.' shorter than current. maria: UI nit — the thresholds 'stepper' control is too close to the label on mobile. add 6px left margin on breakpoints <= 480px. keith: also suggest moving the 'Preview notifications' action to be inline with the channel selection, not at the bottom. users expect immediate preview next to channels. jordan: hmm that reduces vertical flow. What about inline icon button 'preview' with a 3-dot menu fallback for advanced preview options? sam: works for me. one accessibility check: preview modal should trap focus and announce "Preview of notification payload" via aria-live polite. aria-bot: Accessibility check: preview modal must set aria-modal="true" and focus on the first interactive element. jordan: thanks aria-bot. Back to copy: current SLO label 'Target' — some PMs prefer 'Target (%)'. Thoughts? maria: keep 'Target' in compact contexts; use 'Target (%)' as hover helper in a tooltip. less visual noise. keith: small style thing — increase the tokenized threshold chips' min-height to 28px so the text baseline aligns with other inputs. jordan: noted. who can update figma and PR the spacing + copy? maria: I can update figma tonight. will add variants for pill selector and dropdown for small screens. sam: I'll run a quick contrast pass and post palette fixes. keith: I'll prototype the aria attributes and keyboard nav example in the component library branch. jordan: plan: maria updates figma (by EOD), keith prototypes a11y branch, sam handles colors. I'll assemble a short canary rollout doc for product before we ship. thanks all :thumbsup:
